1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent, __wherein the binder is a premixed solder paste__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and the binder is thermally conductive epoxy resin__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the composition further comprises a curing agent__.
